title: The work description question is a tall textarea
description:
The fit-block work description asks for enough detail to understand a use case. A single-line text input cannot hold that answer.

**Done when:** GET /waitlist/survey marks the work description question as multiline, and the beta survey form renders it as a tall textarea (not a one-line input). Other free-text questions stay single-line.

```gherkin
Feature: Waitlist survey submission

Scenario: the work description question is a tall textarea
  Given the waitlist survey API
  Then GET /waitlist/survey marks the work description question as multiline

Scenario: the beta form renders a textarea for the work description
  Given a visitor on the beta pitch page
  When the survey form is rendered
  Then the work description question is a tall textarea
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Work description is a single-line input today. Adding multiline on the survey definition and a tall textarea on the beta form.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Work description is a tall textarea: survey API marks work_description multiline; beta form renders an 8-row resizable textarea. PR #274 against develop.
